notes.text: It only looks right in your conditions — so check it in the others.
Variants tab — read your app under another theme, size, direction or language.
Only what got worse — a choice you made is never reported back at you.
Findings you can act on — cut off, pushed off screen, contrast lost, text that stayed small.
Three ways to read it — by variant, as a table, or one at a time.
Save as PDF — the whole run as a document, pictures and all.
Every axis explains itself — what it varies, and three of its values.
Your list, per project — remembered against that application, not the next one.
Axes of your own — your tenant's colours, your density, your hardware profile.
A Language axis — declare your cultures; right-to-left comes with them.
Nothing left behind — every change put back, even when a check throws.
run_variants over MCP — an agent names an axis and its values.
An agent's findings now reach your open Problems tab, not a list only it could see.
The MCP tool list marks every tool that can change your app, not just the input ones.
The highlight's size chip was drawn off the top edge on a scaled canvas.
